item.title: Cronic Digital
item.description: Worked alongside Cronic Digital for over five years directing and producing audiovisual projects, campaigns, and branded content. A big part of my work there was exploring new creative workflows, especially integrating AI into production and post-production processes to push ideas further while keeping everything efficient and scalable.

item.title: Jimmy Kim TV
item.description: Edited 27+ YouTube videos for Jimmy Kim TV in 2025, covering travel, food, and experience content. Work focused on Adobe Premiere Pro with light After Effects motion graphics, emphasizing pacing, narrative clarity, and authentic vlog style. The videos collectively surpassed 4.53 million views within one year, reflecting strong audience engagement and performance.

item.title: La Mondo En Ekvilibro
item.description: Conceptual cinematic series I created for La Mondo en Ekvilibro around the Mondo token and the idea of environmental preservation. Each piece explores the theme in a different way using AI, stock footage, motion graphics, plus my own direction and editing work. The series moves between different narrative and visual approaches, from more direct concept explorations to a more emotional storytelling angle, including a multi-generational story connected by the same environment and the idea of impact on nature.

item.title: Lixo Carmesim
item.description:
Stop-motion short film funded by the Paulo Gustavo Audiovisual Grant (2023) and produced in 2024 by Studio Ponta with the Fundação Cultural de Balneário Camboriú, in partnership with the Ministério da Cultura and the Federal Government of Brazil. I worked on rig removal, cleanup, and post-production in Adobe Photoshop and After Effects, going frame by frame across 4,000+ frames over three months.

Click here to watch the film.

item.title: Nice N Raw
item.description:
Worked on direction, production, and editing for the Nice N Raw YouTube channel, handling everything from on-set direction and camera work to full post-production. Editing was done mainly in Adobe Premiere Pro, with After Effects. In total, 30+ videos were produced, reaching 71,052 views, with a consistent focus on storytelling, pacing, and a cohesive channel identity.
